nodes.label: Accessible Platform Conformance
nodes.rationale: Platform-native structure, semantic theming, touch targets, system gestures, and accessibility settings are required for a trustworthy native experience.

nodes.label: Product-Specific Expression
nodes.rationale: Expressive color, motion, copy, and delight should arise from the product mechanism and selected visual world, not generic decoration.

nodes.label: Context-Appropriate Design
nodes.rationale: Adaptation must rethink the experience for the target device, input method, constraints, and usage context instead of merely scaling pixels.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Quality Verification
nodes.rationale: Quality is assessed on built output using batched inspection and concrete evidence, rather than design intent or unverified assumptions.

nodes.label: Scope-Preserving Refinement
nodes.rationale: Refinement should strengthen the named target in the existing system while preserving identity, behavior, claims, and all untouched scope.

nodes.label: Mobile Requester Forms
nodes.rationale: Forms become a vertical mobile sequence with 48px controls and full-width actions.

nodes.label: Operational Service Ledger
nodes.rationale: Calm operational handoff with ledger dividers and restrained navy/cobalt emphasis.

nodes.label: Google Sheets Operational Storage
nodes.rationale: Google Sheets is the sole store for tickets, systems, and engineer users, without a database or localStorage.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md Design System Documentation
nodes.rationale: Captures durable visual decisions as normative tokens with contextual prose.

nodes.label: Live Variant Generation
nodes.rationale: Provides a fast path from a requested element and direction to browser-based variant selection.

nodes.label: Product Truth Initialization
nodes.rationale: Records durable product facts in PRODUCT.md before visual decisions are made.

nodes.label: Native iOS Interface Guidance
nodes.rationale: Preserves platform conventions for navigation, touch, typography, color, controls, motion, and verification.

nodes.label: Spatial Layout Thesis
nodes.rationale: Changes structural hierarchy within an established visual world without replacing that identity.

nodes.label: Live Design Iteration
nodes.rationale: Runs a browser-assisted cycle of variants, user selection, carbonization, and cleanup.

nodes.label: Live Mode Setup
nodes.rationale: Configures development-only live instrumentation, drift recovery, and consent-gated CSP handling.

nodes.label: New Visual Work Workflow
nodes.rationale: Separates product truth, durable visual identity, and route-specific surface strategy.

nodes.label: Region Mapping
nodes.rationale: Records containment and repetition in an approved composition before implementation.

nodes.label: Surface Briefing
nodes.rationale: Uses an interview and a resolved direction to create a bounded surface brief.

nodes.label: Typographic System
nodes.rationale: Improves established typography without silently replacing the product's visual identity.

nodes.label: Direction Comps and Asset Production
nodes.rationale: Uses approval of a direction composition as the contract for later implementation and asset work.

nodes.label: Incremental Design System Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extract only patterns that are demonstrably reusable now rather than speculative future abstractions.

nodes.label: Proportional Testing
nodes.rationale: Testing is required in proportion to every project change.

nodes.label: Clarify Ambiguous User Instructions
nodes.rationale: When a user command, instruction, or prompt is unclear, ambiguous, or lacks sufficient scope for a safe decision, ask for clarification and wait for the user response instead of assuming unspecified details.

nodes.label: Simple Scoped Implementation
nodes.rationale: Changes avoid overengineering, unnecessary complexity, and work outside the approved scope.

nodes.label: Local Demo Persistence Decision
nodes.rationale: A functional local demo enables submission, tracking, dashboard filtering, and status updates without introducing a database or external service before credentials are approved.

nodes.label: Requester-Safe Progress Separation
nodes.rationale: Requester-visible progress is kept separate from internal technical classification so dashboard data does not expose technical notes.

nodes.label: Experience Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Makes existing capabilities feel extraordinary without introducing new product capabilities.

nodes.label: Whole-Path Interface Polish
nodes.rationale: Uses evidence and triage to improve hierarchy, visuals, interaction states, content, and code across a complete user path.

nodes.label: Quiet Design Refinement
nodes.rationale: Reduces visual weight while retaining deliberate, non-generic character.

nodes.label: Requester Flow
nodes.source_location: ## Direction contract, STORY and FIRST VIEWPORT

nodes.label: Interface Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Improves loading, rendering, animation, network, and Core Web Vitals performance.

nodes.label: Interface Hardening
nodes.rationale: Production interfaces must remain usable with imperfect content, failures, accessibility needs, and boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Design Quality Hooks
nodes.rationale: Automates mechanical design-quality checks while preserving reviewed exception handling.

nodes.label: Onboarding Experience
nodes.rationale: Gets users to meaningful value quickly through contextual and respectful guidance.

nodes.label: Task-Focused Product UI
nodes.rationale: Design serves users completing operational tasks in authenticated and data-oriented interfaces.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Command Guidance
nodes.rationale: Routes requests to the most relevant visual workflow using project context and detector evidence.
